summary: Backend: 17/17 pytest cases green covering the new apply-with-body contract (422 on missing/empty pitch/negative rate, 200 with pitch trimmed + quoted_rate, 409 duplicate, 403 brand, 401 unauth, 404 draft/closed/invalid) and detail-embeds-application (has_applied + application {id,state,pitch,quoted_rate,agreed_amount,created_at}). Frontend: happy-path apply flow works end-to-end — dialog opens with rate pre-filled to 8000, exact fee-note text present, submit with 9000 closes dialog, applied-status-card renders APPLIED / pitch / ₹9,000, and it persists across reload. Cancel + Escape both close the dialog. Two spec deviations found on the frontend — see frontend_issues.

ui_bugs.issue: Textarea and Input have HTML5 `required` attribute, so submitting empty pitch or empty rate triggers the browser-native 'Please fill out this field' tooltip and never reaches the JS validation branch. As a result, the spec-required inline apply-error messages ('Please write a one or two line pitch.' / 'Please enter a valid quoted rate.') are unreachable via normal UI interaction. Manually removing `required` shows the JS check does fire correctly for the empty-pitch case ('Please write a one or two line pitch.').

Spec: 'Brand user visiting a campaign detail sees an "Only creator accounts can apply" notice, NOT an apply button.' In reality GET /api/campaigns/{id} is guarded by require_roles('creator','admin'), so a brand hits 403 → CampaignDetail falls through to the 'Campaign not found' error state. The sidebar branch that renders the 'Only creator accounts can apply' notice is never reached because `campaign` is null. Either open GET /campaigns/{id} to brands (read-only) or render the notice on the error path.

action_items: Remove HTML5 `required` from apply-pitch-input / apply-rate-input (or add noValidate on the <form>) so the JS validation and inline `apply-error` message fire per spec.

Fix brand-on-campaign-detail behaviour: either allow brands to GET /api/campaigns/{id} (returning has_applied=false + application=null and no apply UI), or render the 'Only creator accounts can apply' notice on the error/not-found fallback when the user is a brand. Currently brands see 'Campaign not found'.

get_campaign embeds application inline — clean. Consider also returning `budget_per_creator` echo in the apply response for symmetry, so the client doesn't need to hold on to the campaign object.

ApplyDialog validates rate with `Number.isFinite(numericRate) || numericRate < 0` but empty string coerces to 0 (Number('') === 0) which passes; this is why the empty-rate branch also relies on HTML5 `required`. Consider explicit `rate === ''` check.
Dialog form uses `required` HTML5 attrs on Textarea/Input — conflicts with the custom apply-error contract. Pick one validation model.

rca of the issue: 1) apply-error not reachable: JSX puts `required` on Textarea and Input; when the form is submitted the browser HTML5 constraint validation fires first and blocks the JS onSubmit, so setError() never runs and [data-testid=apply-error] is not rendered. Reproduction: open dialog, click submit with empty pitch — you see the native browser tooltip, not apply-error. Fix: drop `required` or add `noValidate` on the form. 2) Brand notice not reachable: GET /api/campaigns/{id} depends on require_roles('creator','admin'), so brands get 403 → api.get throws → CampaignDetail renders the 'Campaign not found' fallback and never mounts the sidebar 'Only creator accounts can apply' notice. Fix options: allow brand role to read campaign detail (server-side) OR in the fallback, check user.role==='brand' and render the notice.
